name: Did You Lose This?
label: Quest
description: Did You Lose This?: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have done much for the Order, friend. The sheer dedication it takes to get this far would have turned away any ordinary person. There is no doubt in my mind, or in the mind of Galvan, that you are one of us.
Which is why I think you deserve a little reward. It is nothing really, just a trinket. You may be familiar with its properties, as I do believe it is what brought you to us in the first place.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Today we finalize our celebration of your commitment to the Order.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Rise and be recognized, friend, blacksmith of the Mithril Order.
